Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
The vtes.net website has been hacked for a few years now. Therefore, it's DotNetNuke modules are not being updated and do not work now.

The website owner offered me the possibility of migrating the online card-making tool (which I own) to another website of my choice.

He said I'd need someone who can code in asp.net.

I have been thinking about hosting it on vekn.net, but since vekn.net is running under Linux (and ASP.NET requires a Windows server), it would require to make the website compliant to Mono, which is a .NET runtime for Linux.

Any help on this will be greatly appreciated.

V:EKN Website Coordinator
